svg.aria-label: Second In Command: Agentis Lux, live. Your website has a second audience now: AI agents. Shows what retrieval agents experience when they read your site. Paste a URL or an OpenAPI spec, get one report across six categories for frontend and API. Findings, not fixes. Full CI, smoke-tested deploys, SSRF hardening on every redirect hop.
